19K likes, 92 comments - wanderwithsky on October 6, 2026: "The land of the midnight sun. 🧿🇳🇴

24 hours of daylight is a mind-frying experience. Watching the sun refuse to dip below the horizon, hover, glow, and keep going like time forgot how to work, is honestly one of the most surreal things I’ve ever witnessed. Your body says it’s night. The sky laughs and says not here, not today. Norway doesn’t do subtle. 🏴‍☠️❤️

Which natural phenomenon is still on your bucket list? 👇🧿

#MidnightSun #Norway #WanderWithSky".

Thanks Dad for letting me try, it worked cause you never lost faith in me and for you all never forget who stood with you when you were nobody. Because when you become somebody, fancier rooms, bigger tables, louder applause, those first few? They’re your real circle. The ones who clapped before anyone else even knew your name. Show up for them. Pick up their call. Fly across the world if they need you. Because the only loyalty worth keeping is the kind that remembers both sides of the climb. 🙏🏻

#WanderWithSky".

31K likes, 246 comments - wanderwithsky on October 3, 2026: "Match made in heaven 🏴‍☠️🥵

Told her it’s just 1.3 km. Didn’t mention the 500m straight up. Festvågtind, Lofoten: a short sunset hike in Norway, sunset at 9 PM, the clock running, her legs not, and me saying “bas aa hi gaya” more times than I can count. @aparajita.misra hates hiking. She had every reason to turn back — and didn’t.
Somewhere between the complaints and the summit, I met a new side of her: the fighter. Trek maine plan kiya tha, jeet uski thi 🤍

Send this to the one who always says “bas aa hi gaya” 🫂🧿

#WanderWithSky #OGAwara #Lofoten #Norway".

posts.meta_description:
46K likes, 107 comments - wanderwithsky on October 3, 2026: "The home we didn’t know we needed. 🚐

2 weeks inside @touring_cars watching fjords through the kitchen window, mountains at the bedside, and a front porch that changed every single morning. 🏔️❤️

#Norway #Lofoten #MotorhomeLife #WanderWithSky

This is what “waking up in Norway” actually looks like. 🧿 No alarm. No curtains. Just mountains deciding when you open your eyes. 🏔️❤️

Every tea break came with a view like this. 🧿🫖 The dashboard became our balcony, the fjord our front yard. Norway doesn’t do boring pit stops. 🏴‍☠️

Meet our ride or should I call home for 2 weeks — the @touring_cars. 🚐🧿 Big enough to live in. Small enough to park next to a fjord. The perfect wingman for a country this wild. 🏔️❤️

Every road in Norway deserves a soundtrack. Mirror-still lakes, roads built for the view, and a motorhome that just kept delivering frames I’ll remember forever. 🏴‍☠️❤️

Golden hour, Arctic edition 🌅 Set up two chairs. Opened a drink. Watched the sun refuse to fully set over the Norwegian Sea. These were the best nights of the trip. ❤️

Aparajita cooked dinners >>>> restaurant tables. 🍲 Working, cooking, laughing — all under one tiny roof on wheels. Living small never felt so full. ❤️

“Where are you staying tonight?” 🧿 Honestly, we never knew. And that was the whole point. 🏴‍☠️❤️

Norway from above — because sometimes you have to zoom out to realise how lucky you were to be inside a frame like this. 🧿🏔️ Nine days. One motorhome. A lifetime of memories. ❤️".

178K likes, 1,656 comments - wanderwithsky on September 30, 2026: "Happy Gandhi Jayanti 🙏🏻🧿

Bapu gave us a vision — of cleanliness, of non-violence, of self-reliance, of a Bharat we’d be proud to hand over to the next generation. 80 years later, take a walk down any street and honestly ask yourself — is this the India he dreamed of? The country doesn’t get better in speeches or hashtags. It gets better when every one of us picks up after ourselves, speaks up when it matters, and treats this land like the mother she is. Bapu did his part. The rest is on us. 🇮🇳❤️

#MahatmaGandhi #Bapu #WanderWithSky".

42K likes, 249 comments - wanderwithsky on October 1, 2026: "One in million chance to experience something like this… the Northern Lights + Full moon + Midnight Sun, all in one Arctic sky 🌌🌕

This almost shouldn’t be possible. Midnight sun needs summer. Aurora needs winter darkness. They’re opposite seasons — most of the year, you have to pick one. But for a tiny window in early September, as the Arctic tilts back from endless daylight into returning darkness, Norway lets you catch both in the same week — a sky still glowing from the midnight sun on one horizon, aurora dancing on the other, and a full moon sitting right in between. That’s the magic of standing above the Arctic Circle at the exact moment the seasons trade places. 🏴‍☠️❤️

Which Arctic phenomenon are you chasing first? Drop it 👇🧿

#Norway #Lofoten #NorthernLights #WanderWithSky".

41K likes, 113 comments - wanderwithsky on September 29, 2026: "The magestic Matind Peak 🏔️
Cargos from @awara_in 

An altitude of 408 does not sound like much, but the spectacular view from Måtinden is out of this world. From the summit you will glance down at craggy mountains, white sandy beaches, endless oceans and the idyllic Bleik Island, which is the home of bird species like puffins, razorbills, guillemots, cormorants and eagles.

#Norway #WanderWithSky".

#ISOPURE #ZeroCarb #Protein #WanderWithSky".

13K likes, 125 comments - wanderwithsky on September 24, 2026: "The road wasn’t the opponent, I was ⚡

Taking one of the Top 3 most dangerous roads on Earth, up to Saach Pass - the gateway to Pangi. Every turn where the smart move was to head back, I went further instead. The only guy who could’ve stopped me was me - and he didn’t make the climb. Thums Up XForce rode shotgun the whole way, all thunder no sugar. 🧿

#Collab #ThumsUpXForce #AllThunderNoSugar #IAmThunder #WanderWithSky OGAwara".
